chunks: So set your face towards the straight path before the day arrives from God which is irreversible. Men will be segregated on that day.

key_terms.يَوْمٌ لَا مَرَدَّ لَهُ: a day from which there is no return/irreversible day

ai.seo_question: What does it mean to set one's face towards the straight path before the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Ar-Rum, this verse serves as a pivotal transition from the historical signs of Allah's power to the ultimate eschatological reality, urging believers to maintain steadfastness (istiqamah) in the 'straight religion' (al-din al-qayyim). Shia scholarship often interprets 'al-din al-qayyim' not merely as Islam generally, but specifically as the religion of the Ahl al-Bayt and the Imams who preserve the true essence of the faith against deviation. The imagery of people being 'cleaved asunder' (yassadda'un) underscores the finality of divine judgment, where the unity of the faithful is contrasted with the fragmentation of those who turned away.
